sloka: कर्मान्तरे तदा विप्रा हेतुवादान् बहूनपि ।प्राहुः सुवाग्मिनो धीराः परस्पर जिगीषया ॥१-१४-१९॥
transliteration: karmāntare tadā viprā hetuvādān bahūnapi ।prāhuḥ suvāgmino dhīrāḥ paraspara jigīṣayā ॥1-14-19॥

translations.english: Here (in this sacrificial pavillion), there was none who was not versed in six Vedangas, not true to vows, not learned in many sastras nor adept in discussions (on sastras).
